documents.title: Annual Report 2025
documents.raw_content: Annual Report 2025. Revenue rose 8 percent to EUR 412 million and the order backlog reached a record EUR 1.1 billion. In September 2025 our Leipzig plant was re-certified to ISO/TS 22163 (IRIS) with no major findings. Risk report: we depend on a single supplier for sintered brake discs; a disruption at this supplier could delay our deliveries. Consolidated balance sheet at 31 December 2025 (EUR million): current assets 186.0; total assets 402.5; current liabilities 121.3; total equity 158.9; retained earnings 97.4. EBIT for 2025 was EUR 24.6 million. S&P Global Ratings affirmed Veltrava at BB+ with a stable outlook in May 2025. Our EcoVadis score is 68 (Gold, 2025). Our TRIR was 1.9 in 2025. Veltrava Rail Components develops and builds brake systems and door actuators for regional trains, metros and trams.
